title: Set of bounded-size object isomorphism classes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with generator $U$. For an object $M$ of $\mathcal A$ its *size* $|M|$ is the cardinality of the set of subobjects of $M$. Let $\kappa$ be a cardinal. (1) If $|M|\le\kappa$, then $M$ is a quotient of a direct sum of at most $\kappa$ copies of $U$. (2) The isomorphism classes of objects $M$ of $\mathcal A$ with $|M|\le\kappa$ form a set.
